name: B2·3 AI Content Factory — weekly captions + best-post recycler + trend research (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Variables: **GEMINI_API_KEY**, **TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID**, **BRAND_NAME**. Attach Telegram + Google Sheets credentials.
2. Spreadsheet tabs needed:
   • **Products** (Name, Purity, Weight, Price, Notes) — your catalog rows.
   • **ContentBank** (Date, Caption, Used) — generated captions land here.
   • **BestPosts** (Caption, Link, LastUsed) — paste your all-time best posts once.
3. Replace REPLACE_SHEET_ID in all Sheets nodes. Activate.

## HOW IT RUNS
• **Mon 10:00** — takes 5 products → Gemini writes a week of captions (EN + Kannada mix, hashtags) → saved to ContentBank + sent to Telegram.
• **Thu 10:00** — picks the oldest BestPost not used in 60 days → sends to Telegram: 'repost this today' (evergreen recycler).
• **Sat 10:00** — Gemini researches current jewellery content trends/hooks → 5 reel ideas to Telegram.

## 🔧 FIX
• Empty captions → Products tab empty or GEMINI key invalid.
• Kannada odd → tweak the prompt language line.
• Want auto-posting? Chain ContentBank into B2·2 Omni Publisher.

return text.split(/\n(?=\d[\).:])/).filter(x=>x.trim()).map(c => ({ json: { Date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10), Caption: c.trim(), Used: 'no' } }));
